objective: Fix audit C3 defects (verification/audit-C3-2026-11-13.json). MAJOR 1 (hotkeys.py _sync_physical, :292-309): physical-state recovery must only apply to keys whose physical state was observed DOWN at least once since their key-down (track `_seen_physical_down[vk]`; sample is_physically_down on each tick and on key events); a key never seen physically down (swallowed by a downstream hook) is never dropped by sync, regardless of auto-repeat. Keep the 1.2 s rule for keys that were seen down. Tests: default combo RightAlt+RightShift with RightAlt swallowed (is_physically_down False for RightAlt, True for RightShift) held 3 s with RightShift auto-repeat -> exactly one start translate and no stop until the real key-up; single swallowed key hold unchanged; genuine missed key-up (seen down once, then physically up, no repeats) still recovers after 1.2 s. Real-key scenario in scripts/check_hotkey_hook.py: downstream hook swallows F24, hold F24+F23 for 3 s with F23 auto-repeat -> [start translate, stop at ~3 s]. MAJOR 2 (liveness probe resets the system idle timer): the probe may only be injected when GetLastInputInfo shows user input within the last `interval` seconds (user is active, so the system idle timer is not meaningfully affected) AND the hook has seen no keyboard callback for `interval` seconds; when the user is idle, do nothing (no injection, no reinstall). Make `liveness_decision` take `last_user_input` as an argument and test: idle user -> 'idle' (never 'probe'); active user without callbacks -> 'probe'; active user with callbacks -> 'ok'. Verify with GetLastInputInfo in check_hotkey_hook.py that, while no input is injected for 3 s and the interval is 0.5 s, the measured idle time grows monotonically (no probe fired). MINOR: in tray.py call ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx(hwnd, SHOW message, MSGFLT_ALLOW=1) after creating the tray window so a lower-integrity second instance can reach it; check the PostMessageW return value in desktop.claim_single_instance and log a warning if it fails (still exit 0). Document the accepted trade-off from minor 3 (continuation within 1.5 s after a sync-drop) as a code comment.
